research_integrity: The universal theorem is supported by an explicit natural poset map and subgroup-wise fiber proof. Finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof. Independent verification was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite loopless simple strongly connected digraphs with at least two vertices; no homeomorphism to sphere claimed for original arc complex. Does not compute integral quotient torsion. Full Björner–Welker 1999 text not accessible and definitive priority remains unresolved.
title: An equivariant source-set sphere for acyclic subgraphs of every strongly connected digraph
